calls.bash: eval "$(mu agent remote-env w1 -w eval --shell)"; mu agent spawn w1 -w eval --command "ssh $MU_SSH_ARGS dev -t 'cd ~/ws/w1 && $MU_REMOTE_ENV \$SHELL -ilc \"pi --approve\"'"
mu task claim rt2 -w eval --for w1 --evidence 'remote on dev'
mu agent send w1 -w eval --fresh --json 'do rt2; mu is not on this host; end with the CLOSE/REPORT block'
mu task close rt2 -w eval --evidence 'eval: rt2.sh exit 0 run=00000000'
git fetch "ssh://dev/~/ws/w1" HEAD && git cherry-pick FETCH_HEAD
